title: Find the Minimum Number of Fibonacci Numbers Whose Sum Is K
summary: For a given integer k, determine the least count of Fibonacci numbers that add up to k, allowing repetition of any Fibonacci number.
statement: For a given integer k, determine the least count of Fibonacci numbers that add up to k, allowing repetition of any Fibonacci number.
constraints: Use Fibonacci numbers starting 1, 2, 3, 5, and so on; values may be reused.
Return the minimum number whose sum is exactly k.
hints: Repeatedly take the largest value not exceeding the remainder.
Move downward until the remainder is zero.
The Fibonacci recurrence ensures replacing the largest choice cannot use fewer smaller terms.
editorial: The Fibonacci recurrence ensures replacing the largest choice cannot use fewer smaller terms.

tests.explanation: Five plus two reaches seven using two Fibonacci numbers.
Thirteen plus five plus one reaches nineteen using three.
